classification.novelty_scope: new project synthesis and unmarked classification/finiteness packaging of the published Nikulin--Vinberg--Roulleau classification; no new abstract polytope or strict-M3c closure is claimed
classification.one_unmarked_chamber_type_per_lattice_re: W_2(N) acts transitively on complete root chambers
classification.pairwise_abstract_polytope_distinctness: the pair (hyperbolic dimension, facet count) is different for every one of the 19 cases

finite_volume_sublocus.definition: members of K3Root[11,20] whose complete root chamber has finite hyperbolic volume
finite_volume_sublocus.finite_index_equivalence: finite volume is equivalent to [O^+(N):W_2(N)] < infinity; this is a classification output, not an ambient hypothesis
finite_volume_sublocus.name: K3RootFV[11,20]

moduli.irreducibility_scope: Roulleau proves the full coarse N-polarized moduli space irreducible; the exact-Picard locus is asserted only nonempty and of the same dimension, not a separate finite-type irreducible algebraic moduli space
moduli.orientation_and_monodromy_boundary: the oriented arithmetic period/change-of-marking images and chamber orbits are classified; their identification with geometric family monodromy remains conditional on the standard moduli-stack/deck-group interpretation

oriented_arithmetic_period_classificatio.claim_level: exact lattice-theoretic orientation, embedding-orbit, chamber-orbit, and oriented arithmetic period/change-of-marking image classification

finite_discriminant_quotients.interpretation: [O^+(T):tilde O^+(T)] and the corresponding Picard-side stable-chamber-stabilizer index

finite_quadratic_form_provenance.ADE_q_forms: table-derived from the standard ADE discriminant-form values encoded in Q4_FACTOR_TABLE and _factor_discriminant_label
finite_quadratic_form_provenance.orthogonal_group_orders: algorithmically enumerated from the table-derived finite forms; EXPECTED_DISCRIMINANT_ORTHOGONAL_ORDERS are regression values, not a second inverse-Gram derivation
finite_quadratic_form_provenance.smith_invariants: independently recomputed from the integral U plus negative-ADE Gram matrices

oriented_arithmetic_period_classificatio.geometric_monodromy_status: conditional on the standard moduli-stack/deck-group identification; not independently certified
oriented_arithmetic_period_classificatio.normalizer_warning: O^+(T) is the T/period image of Gamma^+_{j,C}, not an identification Gamma^+_{j,C}=O^+(T)

definition: N is an even lattice of signature (1,rho-1), 11 <= rho <= 20
C is a component of the complement of every square-minus-two root hyperplane
surface_free_class.name: K3Root[11,20]

C.proof: the K3 Weyl-chamber theorem identifies the nef cone with the complete component cut by all square-minus-two roots; Roulleau's lists are complete curve configurations

R.proof: Weyl transitivity changes the NS marking so that extraction recovers the prescribed labelled lattice and chamber
R.warning: forgetting the integral marking is many-to-one on period points

U.proof: primitive K3 embedding plus period surjectivity produces an exact-Picard K3 surface for every ambient member; Nikulin--Vinberg exhaust the finite-volume/finite-index locus

V.proof: the surface classification puts each listed row in the finite-automorphism/polyhedral-effective-cone locus, hence W_2(N) has finite index in arithmetic O^+(N) and its fundamental chamber has finite hyperbolic covolume; independently, exact Vinberg/CoxIter endpoint and full affine-neighbourhood audits pass for all nineteen complete wall systems; finite index was not assumed in the ambient class

transfer_theorem.statement: The finite-volume unmarked integral locus of K3Root[11,20], denoted K3RootFV[11,20], consists exactly of the 19 listed cases; each is the complete nef chamber of a nonempty exact-Picard locus in an irreducible lattice-polarized K3 moduli family, and there is no finite-volume rank-20 case.

strict_m3c.completed_scope: unmarked full-root K3 finite-volume classification, all-19 literal Vinberg V, and the oriented arithmetic embedding/chamber/period-image layer
reasons: the ambient class is not the bounded raw IC0 Coxeter specification required by strict M3c
no explicit generators-and-relations presentations are supplied for the 19 infinite arithmetic period groups
geometric family monodromy is not independently certified beyond the conditional standard moduli-stack/deck-group identification
